items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer (CVSS 9.8) allows remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs, including critical Stored XSS (arbitrary code execution) and Path Traversal (arbitrary file system write) vulnerabilities.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique, with attacks observed in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-05
items.summary: This update resolves multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.
